# Stoker

> Launch a coin on Solana priced in the asset you pick: SOL, a stablecoin, a tokenized stock or any asset Raydium quotes. Coins trade on Raydium LaunchLab; creators get half of what the platform collects on their coin's trades.

## Pages
- [Launch a coin](https://stoker.markets/launch)
- [Explore coins](https://stoker.markets/coins)
- [Assets to pair with](https://stoker.markets/assets)
- [Fees](https://stoker.markets/fees)
- [API reference](https://stoker.markets/api)

## API
- GET https://api.stoker.markets/v1/quotes: assets a coin can be paired with
- GET https://api.stoker.markets/v1/stats: coins launched, graduated, 24h volume
- GET https://api.stoker.markets/v1/launches?sort=trending: coins, most traded first
